## This work (Р-251, English works series, one at a time)

Source: the English original `convicts-cthulhu-en` (text layer; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show convicts-cthulhu-en <page>`; page image `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py image convicts-cthulhu-en <physical page> --physical`). Page numbers: `pagemap` often misses printed numbers in these PDFs — look at 2–3 page images and find printed vs physical; in `sources` give the printed page as printed (null for unnumbered pages). Do NOT edit `pipeline/source/books.json` — report the offset (physical = printed − offset, e.g. «p. 3» on physical 4 → offset −1) and the lead sets it.
Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184), e.g. Dreamlands = «Страна грёз»; Hard/Extreme roll = «трудная/чрезвычайная проверка» (official «трудный/чрезвычайный успех», never «сложная»). New terms of this book — choose one Russian form each, use it everywhere, and list them all in your report (English → Russian); the translator of the book will reuse exactly these forms.
- FIRST: check that this scenario is not already in the base under a Russian translation (Grep key character and place names, transliterated, in `kb/books/*-ru/`; e.g. «The Haunted Clubhouse» was already there as «Маленький клуб ужасов»). If it is — do NOT create a second set: per Р-147 the translation keeps the text, the original gives the numbers; write proposals to the translation records (English sources, `name.en`, errata for translation errors) and report.
- Colonial Australia 1788–1840s: era other. A line of 15 PDFs split into 5 units — see «Shared scheme» below.
- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene (`arc`), characters (stat blocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters with role `pregen`; unnamed crowds — group profile with invented `names`, Р-151), creatures (known Mythos creatures and deities → `instance_of` the shared record, Grep `kb/creatures` first; a unique being — book record), organizations, items and clues, tomes and spells (known spells → refs to the shared `coc:spell:*`), handouts (text as printed + our full translation), places (a real city — the shared record `coc:location:<city>` if it exists (Grep first), book places `part_of` it; a fictional town — a book place with its places `part_of` it; do not create shared records in `kb/locations/`), maps (`map` records with a spot on every printed label, Р-206; every key number without a record gets a small place record).
- Helper scripts — only in your own scratchpad subfolder `gen-convicts` (other helpers run in parallel and use the same scratchpad).
- Book-scoped ids: see «Shared scheme» (each registered book has its own folder).
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241, Р-245): portraits, creature art, handouts, item pictures, maps — mapping `checks/20261124-convicts/art.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real; apply the proposals yourself (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) — you own this book; atmosphere pictures (cover, decoration, mood art not tied to a record) → `checks/20261124-convicts/atmosphere.json` (the lead merges it). File prefix for pictures: `convicts-`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; maps are `map` records, not atmosphere; no two records with the same `name.ru`; terms inside text agree with the record names; book misprints kept as printed, in `errata`, with the obvious ones fixed in `corrections`.
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books convicts-cthulhu-en --out checks/20261124-convicts/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books convicts-cthulhu-en --out checks/20261124-convicts/scenario` and fix what they find; then `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/convicts-cthulhu-en` — 0 errors.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261124-convicts/convicts.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason), misprints, and the term list (English → Russian).

## Shared scheme of this line (5 units work in parallel — keep to it exactly)

Convicts & Cthulhu (Cthulhu Reborn, Geoff Gillan / Dean Engelhardt et al., 2016–2018) — 7e (the library labels say [EN 6e], WRONG: the line is 7e; check the stat blocks). Colonial New South Wales, 1788–1840s (Sydney/Port Jackson, Parramatta, Norfolk Island, Van Diemen's Land…): era `other`. Each PDF is its own registered book: `convicts-cthulhu-en` (core, 98 pp.), `convicts-cthulhu-players-en` (Players Version, 57 pp. — a subset of the core book), Ticket of Leave issues `convicts-tol-NN-en` (NN = 01–12, 15; small supplements: scenarios, articles, NPCs, places). Records of book X live in `kb/books/X/` with ids `X/<kind>/<slug>`.
- A Ticket of Leave issue is not necessarily a scenario: decide per issue (scenario → `scenario` record with scenes; article about a place/people/creatures → place/character/creature/rule records; NPC gallery → characters). Read the issue first.
- Unit core owns the core book: setting and history (rules/rule records by kb-rules-book), occupations (shared `kb/occupations` drafts in `checks/20261124-convicts/new-shared/` — do NOT write kb/occupations yourself; the lead moves them), skills (same), places of the colony, organizations, people, creatures, any scenario in the core book. The Players Version: only add its pages to `sources` of the matching core records (same unit) — no duplicate records; anything only in the Players Version → records in `kb/books/convicts-cthulhu-players-en/`.
- Real places: Sydney etc. — Grep `kb/locations` first (`coc:location:sydney`?); if no shared record, the core unit creates book places in `convicts-cthulhu-en` (e.g. `convicts-cthulhu-en/location/sydney-town`) and the ToL units refer to those ids (slug of the English name; dangling until core finishes — list them; no stubs). Recurring colony figures (governors etc.) — owned by core; ToL units refer to `convicts-cthulhu-en/character/<slug>`.
- Coverage file `checks/20261124-convicts/convicts-<unit>.md`; art mapping `art-<unit>.json`, atmosphere `atmosphere-<unit>.json`, proposals `proposals-<unit>.json`; picture prefix `convicts-<unit>-`.
- completeness/scenario_check on your own books into `checks/20261124-convicts/completeness-<unit>` / `scenario-<unit>`; `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/<your books>` — 0 errors except dangling refs to core's scheme ids.
